basic_details.job_title: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Increased - Apply Online for 1909 Junior Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB), Jaipur, has released the , increasing the vacancies from 874 to 1,909 Junior Engineer posts. The recruitment covers Civil, Electrical and Mechanical/Electrical Engineering positions for Degree and Diploma holders in six Rajasthan Government departments. Candidates with a relevant Engineering Degree or Diploma and knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script and Rajasthani culture can apply. The general age limit is 18 to 40 years as on 1 January 2027, with applicable relaxations. The online application process has reopened on 18

how_to_apply: Visit sso.rajasthan.gov.in.
Log in using your Rajasthan SSO ID and password.
Open Citizen Apps (G2C) and select Recruitment Portal.
Find Junior Engineer Combined Direct Recruitment 2026 under Advertisement No. 10/2026.
Read the revised notification and post-specific eligibility rules.
Complete the One-Time Registration process if not already registered.
Pay the applicable OTR fee if it has not been paid previously.
Select the eligible Junior Engineer post category.
Verify personal, category and contact information.
Enter the required educational and Engineering qualification details.
Upload the necessary qualification documents through the prescribed document-upload facility.
Upload a recent photograph in accordance with the portal instructions.
Provide the mandatory visible body identification mark.
Fill in department preferences carefully.
Review the entire application and verify the information entered.
Complete final submission before 17 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Confirm that the portal has generated an Application ID.
Download and retain the final submitted application form.
Important: Candidates applying for different Junior Engineer cadres must submit separate applications for the respective post categories.
Department preferences should be chosen carefully because department allotment is based on merit-cum-priority. The Board may not accept changes outside the designated correction facility.
important_instructions: Candidates who submitted valid applications for the original 874-post recruitment do not need to apply again.
However, they should review the revised department vacancies and department preference rules.
Candidates who previously applied for Junior Engineer Civil Degree or Diploma positions can change their department preference order free of charge from 22 December to 31 December 2026.
The Board will allocate departments according to category-wise merit and preferences submitted by candidates.
However, the candidate's name, father's name, date of birth, photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwriting specimen are excluded from the specified correction facility.
Corrections will not be accepted after the prescribed window, and offline requests will not be entertained.

Previous applicants are not required to submit another application merely because the vacancy count has increased. They should instead use the applicable preference or correction facility when necessary.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Revised Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The revised 45-page notification provides updated department-wise vacancies, reservation details, educational qualifications, age limits, application instructions, special conditions for previous applicants and the proposed examination schedule. Revised Notification PDF: Download RSSB JE Revised Notification 2026

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board has reopened the online application process following the increase in Junior Engineer vacancies. Important: The examination dates are tentative. RSSB has reserved the right to change the schedule and will communicate updates through its official website.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Vacancy 2026 Revised - 1909 Posts
content_sections.text: The Urban Development and Housing Department has the highest number of vacancies, with 770 positions, followed by the Public Works Department with 403 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Revised Notification 2026 - What Has Changed?
content_sections.text: RSSB originally advertised 874 Junior Engineer positions on 15 August 2026. The Board received new departmental requirements and revised vacancy requests, increasing the number to 1,909. Important: The revised notification replaces the earlier vacancy figures. Candidates should use the updated 1,909-post vacancy distribution and revised department preferences.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the relevant Engineering Degree or Diploma specified for their selected Junior Engineer category. Applicants must also possess working knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture, as prescribed in the recruitment rules. Qualification Note: The revised recruitment covers six departments governed by different service rules. Applicants must verify the exact accepted Engineering qualification for the selected post and department in the official notification. Yes. Eligible Diploma holders can apply for Junior Engineer Civil Diploma and Junior Engineer Mechanical/Electrical Diploma vacancies, subject to the respective departmental eligibility requirements. Yes. Candidates possessing a recognized Engineering Degree in the relevant branch can apply for the corresponding Degree-level Junior Engineer positions. A Degree qualification should not be assumed to make a candidate eligible for every separately advertised Diploma cadre. Candidates must follow the eligibility conditions for the specific application category.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The general age requirement is 18 to 40 years as on 1 January 2027 , before applicable age relaxation. The revised notice provides an additional upper-age concession because recruitment was not conducted in certain departments during the specified preceding period. Important: Age-relaxation provisions are governed by the applicable Rajasthan service rules. The notification states that specified relaxation provisions are non-cumulative, and candidates cannot automatically combine multiple concessions.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the recruitment examination and subsequent eligibility and document verification stages. Online application submission. Junior Engineer recruitment written examination. Preparation of merit and shortlisting according to the applicable rules. Document and qualification verification. Department allotment on a merit-cum-priority basis. Final selection and appointment under the relevant departmental rules.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Exam Date 2027
content_sections.text: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board has proposed to conduct the Junior Engineer recruitment examinations from 3 February to 5 February 2027 . Important: The proposed examination dates may change. The Board will publish the final schedule and admit-card instructions through its official website.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Junior Engineers will receive pay according to Rajasthan Pay Matrix Level 10 , subject to the applicable departmental rules. During the prescribed probation period, candidates will receive fixed remuneration according to Rajasthan Government rules. Regular pay and allowances become applicable under the conditions governing successful completion of probation.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Revised Recruitment 2026 - Instructions for Previous Applicants
content_sections.text: Candidates who submitted valid applications for the original 874-post recruitment do not need to apply again. However, they should review the revised department vacancies and department preference rules. Candidates who previously applied for Junior Engineer Civil Degree or Diploma positions can change their department preference order free of charge from 22 December to 31 December 2026 . The Board will allocate departments according to category-wise merit and preferences submitted by candidates. However, the candidate's name, father's name, date of birth, photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwriting specimen are excluded from the specified correction facility. Corrections will not be accepted after the prescribed window, and offline requests will not be entertained. Previous applicants are not required to submit another application merely because the vacancy count has increased. They should instead use the applicable preference or correction facility when necessary.

content_sections.heading: RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the Rajasthan SSO Recruitment Portal between 18 November and 17 December 2026 . Apply Online: Rajasthan SSO Portal Recruitment Portal: recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in Application Closing Time: 11:59 PM on 17 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates applying for different Junior Engineer cadres must submit separate applications for the respective post categories. Department preferences should be chosen carefully because department allotment is based on merit-cum-priority. The Board may not accept changes outside the designated correction facility.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready as applicable: Rajasthan SSO ID and OTR registration details. Class 10 certificate for date-of-birth verification. Engineering Degree or Diploma certificate. Engineering qualification marksheets. Category certificate, where applicable. OBC/MBC Non-Creamy Layer or EWS certificate, where applicable. Scheduled Area residence/eligibility certificate, where applicable. Benchmark Disability certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable. Recent photograph in the required format. Other identity and reservation documents prescribed by the portal. The exact certificates and formats required for individual reservation categories must be checked in the detailed revised notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The revised notification announces 1,909 Junior Engineer vacancies, increased from the original 874 posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 17 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. When will RSSB JE online applications reopen?
faq.answer: The revised online application process starts on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Do candidates who applied earlier need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who already applied under Advertisement No. 10/2026 do not need to submit a fresh application.

faq.question: Q5. Can previous applicants change their department preferences?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible candidates who previously applied for Civil JE Degree or Diploma posts can modify their department preferences free of charge from 22 to 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the RSSB JE age limit?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 18 to 40 years as on 1 January 2027, with applicable category-wise and special departmental relaxations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess the relevant Engineering Degree or Diploma in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, according to the selected post.

faq.question: Q8. Can Diploma holders apply for RSSB Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Diploma holders can apply for the relevant Diploma-level Junior Engineer vacancies if they satisfy the departmental eligibility requirements.

faq.question: Q9. What is the RSSB JE application fee?
faq.answer: The One-Time Registration fee is Rs. 600 or Rs. 400 depending on category. Candidates who already paid the applicable OTR fee do not need to pay it again.

faq.question: Q10. What is the RSSB JE Exam Date 2027?
faq.answer: The recruitment examination is tentatively scheduled from 3 to 5 February 2027.
